title: Filesystem Persistence Layer
description: Create the filesystem persistence service using Tauri FS plugin. Handles reading/writing project metadata JSON files, chapter TipTap JSON files, and directory structure management.
action: Create desktop/src/services/projectFileService.ts with functions for project index read/write, project metadata read/write, chapter content read/write, directory creation. All operations use @tauri-apps/plugin-fs.

convergence.verification: Service functions compile, path constants resolve to correct appDataDir structure
convergence.definition_of_done: All CRUD operations for projects and chapters implemented with proper error handling, directory auto-creation, and path resolution

files.change: New service with project index, project metadata, chapter content read/write, directory management

implementation: 1. Import from @tauri-apps/plugin-fs: readFile, writeFile, mkdir, exists, readDir, BaseDirectory

2. Define path constants: PROJECTS_DIR = 'projects', chapterPath = 'projects/{projectId}/chapters/{chapterId}.json', projectMetaPath = 'projects/{projectId}/project.json', projectIndexPath = 'projects/index.json'
3. Implement readProjectIndex(): read and parse index.json, return Project[] or empty array if not found
4. Implement writeProjectIndex(projects): stringify and write index.json
5. Implement readProjectMeta(projectId): read project.json, return project metadata
6. Implement writeProjectMeta(projectId, data): write project.json with mkdir for project dir
7. Implement readChapterContent(projectId, chapterId): read chapter JSON file, return TipTap JSONContent
8. Implement writeChapterContent(projectId, chapterId, content): write chapter JSON file with mkdir for chapters dir
9. Implement ensureProjectDir(projectId): mkdir -p for project directory structure
test: Integration tests: write and read back project index, chapter content, handle missing files gracefully
reference: useDraftCache.ts for current localStorage persistence pattern (to be replaced)
rationale: Decouples filesystem I/O from store/UI logic, enables TASK-003 (migration) and TASK-005 (editor integration) to use clean API
risks: Tauri FS plugin path resolution on different OS — use BaseDirectory.AppData for consistent paths
